summary:
Planet X Lab is an interactive, multi-module web application designed to bridge the gap between outer-solar-system dynamics and wide-field infrared astronomy, inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission.
The application delivers three core interactive simulations: an Orbit Sandbox that models real-time gravitational perturbations on Trans-Neptunian Objects (TNOs) to locate unseen planetary mass; an Alien Twilight Atmosphere Simulator that generates noisy, SPHEREx-style infrared spectra (0.75 to 5.0 um) and models habitability indices; and a Deep-Space Time Machine exploring logarithmic cosmic distances and redshift (Lambda-CDM) up to the first galaxies.
By turning complex astrophysical equations into an intuitive, zero-install browser experience, Planet X Lab empowers citizen scientists and researchers to visualize how we hunt for elusive worlds like Planet Nine and map the infrared universe.
details:
What it does and how it works: Planet X Lab is an interactive, multi-module web application designed to bridge the gap between outer-solar-system dynamics and wide-field infrared astronomy, inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission. It features three core simulations:

  1. Orbit Sandbox: Models real-time gravitational perturbations on Trans-Neptunian Objects (TNOs) to locate unseen planetary mass.
  2. Alien Twilight Atmosphere Simulator: Generates noisy, SPHEREx-style infrared spectra (0.75 to 5.0 um) and computes planetary habitability indices.
  3. Deep-Space Time Machine: Explores logarithmic cosmic distances and redshift (Lambda-CDM) from the Kuiper Belt out to the first galaxies.

Benefits and Intended Impact: The project turns complex astrophysical equations and open cosmological data into an intuitive, zero-install browser tool. It empowers students, educators, and citizen scientists to visualize how astronomers hunt for elusive worlds like Planet Nine and map the infrared universe.

Tools, Languages, and Software: Built entirely using native HTML5 Canvas, modern JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS variables. It requires no heavy external backend or complex installation, ensuring instant global accessibility via web browsers.

Creativity and Considerations: Planet X Lab stands out by unifying three distinct astronomical scales—planetary dynamics, atmospheric chemistry, and cosmology—into a single seamless interface. Key design factors included responsive performance, scientific realism (such as radiative transfer scattering and N-body gravitational calculations), and a clean dark-mode telemetry aesthetic.
